title: Counterfactual Reasoning for Steerable Pluralistic Value Alignment of Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the alignment of LLM responses with specified pluralistic value profiles. One of the value dimensions used, 'Tradition', is defined as 'Respect and acceptance of cultural or religion customs'. Additionally, one of the datasets, Touché23-ValueEval, includes arguments from religious texts.
findings: The paper does not provide specific findings for religion. The main finding is that the proposed framework, COUPLE, provides more accurate, steerable, and interpretable alignment with fine-grained pluralistic human values (which can include religious values like 'Tradition') compared to baseline methods.
